project.name: FrameContact
project.purpose: Matched audit of contact-derived, independent-node, and explicitly coupled epitope/paratope/contact prediction

scientific_question.primary: Does explicit coupling between a native residue-pair contact matrix and independent epitope/paratope heads improve development contact ranking, node ranking, and partner retrieval beyond repeated supervision of labels derived from the same contact geometry?
scientific_question.label_dependency: AsEP epitope and paratope labels are marginals derived from native residue-pair contacts; they are not treated as three independent biological tasks.
scientific_question.causal_language_rule: Only matched condition and seed differences may be attributed to the changed coupling mechanism. Development associations are not causal biological claims.

evidence_boundary_at_freeze.claim_boundary: This protocol authorizes development fitting and validation only. Frozen, official, and external test roles are forbidden for model selection.

attribution_contract.pair_only_definition: A0 has no epitope BCE, paratope BCE, or pair-node consistency gradient. The same partner-specificity ranking term is held fixed in every condition and must be disclosed when describing A0.
attribution_contract.a0_vs_a1: Effect of adding node-label loss through noisy-OR contact marginals.
attribution_contract.a1_vs_a2: Contact-derived residue outputs versus independent residue heads under matched label-loss weights.
attribution_contract.a2_vs_a3: Effect of pair-to-node Jensen-Shannon consistency with identical model topology.
attribution_contract.a3_vs_a4: Effect of stop-gradient soft coarse node-to-pair routing.
attribution_contract.a4_vs_a5: Effect of joint distance supervision and direct-contact/distogram consistency.

training_objective.contact: Per-complex class-balanced BCE on authenticated native bipartite contact labels.
training_objective.node_labels: Per-complex class-balanced BCE on epitope/paratope marginals derived from the same native contacts.
training_objective.pair_node_consistency: Equal-weight mean of antibody-side and antigen-side per-complex Bernoulli Jensen-Shannon divergence between independent unary logits and noisy-OR contact marginals.
training_objective.specificity: Bidirectional ranking against frozen matched non-cognate partners; wrong partners never receive fabricated all-zero contact labels.

model_selection.checkpoint_rule: For every condition, maximize the minimum bidirectional development-validation compatibility margin; tie-break by mean per-complex contact AUPRC and then earlier epoch. Node metrics never select checkpoints.

primary: pooled and mean per-complex native contact AUPRC
secondary: contact precision, recall, F1, MCC, AUROC
epitope and paratope precision, recall, F1, MCC, AUROC
matched partner retrieval top-1, MRR, and margin
statistics: seed-wise deltas without pooling residue pairs across complexes

confirmatory_order.stage_1: Run all six conditions on epitope_group development train/validation with matched seeds and compute budget.
confirmatory_order.stage_2: Only after the stage-1 aggregation script and comparison rules are frozen, run the core four plus the selected mechanism on epitope_ratio development train/validation.

interpretation_rules: Do not call the three labels independent tasks.
Do not use frozen, official, or external test performance for architecture, hyperparameter, threshold, checkpoint, or baseline selection.
A high AUROC under extreme contact imbalance is not sufficient; AUPRC and precision-oriented metrics remain primary.
A positive contact metric without a positive matched partner margin does not establish partner specificity.
No condition is called superior unless matched five-seed uncertainty supports the stated endpoint.
